Local en venta en Ciudad Lineal – Calle Marcelino Roa Vázquez

Excelente oportunidad comercial en el distrito de Ciudad Lineal, en una zona residencial consolidada con actividad comercial y todos los servicios, próxima a Calle Alcalá y muy bien comunicada.

El inmueble, ubicado en esquina, cuenta con tres fachadas, lo que le aporta gran visibilidad y luminosidad. Dispone de un amplio acceso principal de casi 5 metros de fachada.

Planta baja: 65 m² diáfanos
Sótano: 132 m² aprox. , totalmente diáfano, con ventanas a la calle que aportan luz natural, además de un aseo

inv.desc_en:
Commercial premises for sale in Ciudad Lineal – Marcelino Roa Vázquez Street

Excellent business opportunity in the Ciudad Lineal district, in a well-established residential area with commercial activity and all services, close to Alcalá Street and with excellent transport links.

The property, located on a corner, has three facades, providing great visibility and natural light. It features a wide main entrance with a facade of almost 5 meters.

It is distributed over two floors:

Ground floor: 65 m² open-plan space
Basement: Approximately 132 m², completely open-plan, with windows facing the street providing natural light, plus a restroom

Due to its characteristics, the premises are ideal for multiple activities, such as:
�️ Convenience store
�♀️ Beauty or health center
� Office or academy
☕ Café or takeaway (subject to regulations and obtaining the necessary license)
� Viewings can be arranged now.
